title: Martha Stewart’s Hit iHeartPodcast “The Martha Stewart Podcast” Launches on Netflix
summary: iHeartMedia is a leading global media and entertainment company specializing in radio, digital, mobile, social, live events and on-demand entertainment.
body_markdown:
***The Lifestyle Icon Brings Her Intimate Conversations with the World’s Most Fascinating People to Netflix, Alongside Her Emmy-Nominated Series “Martha Cooks”***


***Listen to “The Martha Stewart Podcast” now***[HERE](https://www.iheart.com/podcast/1119-the-martha-stewart-podcas-98310874/)


**NEW YORK – August 24, 2026 –** Martha Stewart and iHeartPodcasts, the No. 1 podcast publisher globally according to[Podtrac](https://analytics.podtrac.com/podcast-publisher-rankings) , announced today that “The Martha Stewart Podcast” is launching on Netflix as part of iHeartMedia and Netflix’s growing exclusive video podcast partnership, bringing Stewart’s in-depth conversations with notable guests from all walks of life to the streaming service beginning Wednesday, August 26.


Fans will now have a new way to experience “[The Martha Stewart Podcast](https://www.iheart.com/podcast/1119-the-martha-stewart-podcas-98310874/) ,” with full video episodes available to watch on Netflix. The series will also continue as an audio podcast distributed by iHeartPodcasts and available on the iHeartRadio app and everywhere podcasts are heard. Stewart’s Emmy-nominated series “Martha Cooks” is also launching on Netflix, with episodes available beginning Tuesday, August 25.


“I’m delighted to bring my podcast to Netflix, and with that, introduce the medium of video to the series,” said Martha Stewart. “Netflix is the perfect partner to share and amplify the thoughtful and informative conversations the show is known for with an even greater audience.”


Each week on “The Martha Stewart Podcast,” Stewart sits down with a unique mix of captivating guests who inspire and intrigue her, including business icons, entrepreneurs, artisans, old friends and new. Through intimate conversations, Stewart explores their lives, careers, ideas and experiences, uncovering personal stories and insights while giving audiences the opportunity to learn something new with every episode.


“The Martha Stewart Podcast” will launch on Netflix with an episode featuring entrepreneur, investor and Reddit co-founder Alexis Ohanian. Stewart and Ohanian sit down for a wide-ranging conversation about love, ambition, family, pets, investing and life with his wife, Serena Williams. Upcoming episodes will feature bestselling author Harlan Coben and music producer, and Grammy Award-winning producer, artist, actor and New York Times bestselling author benny blanco.


“Martha is one of the most iconic and influential voices in media, with an extraordinary ability to connect with audiences,” said Will Pearson, President of iHeartPodcasts. “We’re thrilled to expand ‘The Martha Stewart Podcast’ to Netflix, giving even more people the opportunity to experience Martha’s signature curiosity, expertise and one-of-a-kind perspective through the candid conversations and insights that have made the podcast so compelling.”


“Martha Cooks,” Stewart’s Emmy-nominated cooking series, will also be available on Netflix beginning August 25. The series brings viewers into Stewart’s kitchen as she shares some of her favorite recipes, techniques and culinary expertise alongside acclaimed chefs, friends and special guests.


Christian Martin, Amy Chiaro and Martha Stewart are Executive Producers, and Heather Kirkland is the Producer of “The Martha Stewart Podcast.”


“The Martha Stewart Podcast” joins a growing slate of iHeartPodcasts available on Netflix as part of[iHeartMedia and Netflix’s exclusive video podcast partnership](https://www.iheartmedia.com/press/netflix-and-iheartmedia-expand-exclusive-video-podcast-partnership-new-star-driven) , bringing some of today’s most influential voices and compelling, conversation-driven programming to the streaming service. The agreement includes all new episodes from the participating podcasts, along with select library episodes from each series. All podcasts included in the partnership, including “The Martha Stewart Podcast,” will continue to be available on iHeartRadio and everywhere podcasts are heard.

**About Martha Stewart**


Martha Stewart is the founder of the first multi-channel lifestyle company, Martha Stewart Living Omnimedia, an entrepreneur, bestselling author of 102 lifestyle books, and Emmy Award-winning television show host. Reaching more than 100 million devoted fans monthly through multi-media platforms and products for the home, sold through Amazon.com and The World of Martha Stewart and an extensive retail network, Martha is the “go-to” authority on the encompassing topic of Living and Celebrating your best life. She and her talented staff provide trusted, timely, and useful information on all aspects of everyday living: cooking, entertaining, gardening, home renovating, collecting, organizing, crafting, healthy living, holidays, weddings, and pet care, across many media formats.


**About Marquee Brands**


Marquee Brands is a globally recognized brand owner, marketer and media company. A leading brand accelerator, Marquee Brands strategically manages a portfolio of renowned consumer brands with global recognition. Established in 2014 by Neuberger Berman, Marquee Brands harnesses and grows the value of its brands by partnering with best-in-class manufacturers, operators, retailers and distributors across multiple channels, geographies and product sectors. Generating over $4.2 billion in annual retail sales, the Marquee Brands portfolio is organized into three distinct verticals: Home & Culinary, Fashion & Lifestyle and Active & Outdoor, and encompasses timeless brands such as Martha Stewart, Emeril Lagasse, Sur La Table, Laura Ashley, America's Test Kitchen, BCBG, Ben Sherman, Bruno Magli, Anti Social Social Club, Totes, Isotoner, Destination Maternity, Motherhood Maternity, A Pea in The Pod, Dakine and Body Glove. For more information visit,[www.marqueebrands.com](http://www.marqueebrands.com/) .
